reviewItem.question: Does "the `--cluster` behavior changed to show flows emitted from nodes outside of the provided cluster name (either coming from or going to the target cluster)" mean a change to cli-flag:cilium|name=--cluster|component=hubble (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: The Hubble CLI `--cluster` flag now also shows flows emitted from nodes outside the named cluster (to or from the target cluster); the old behavior can be reproduced with `--node-name foo/`.
